title: tehas wake --json
description: What tehas wake --json prints, version 1, on exit 0 and 1: whether a poll was asked for. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. The object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. console/src/wake.rs checks that the command prints the sample beside this file.
